--------                                                                    
                                                                              
  **@pierre** wrote on 2026-10-24 15:50:                                      
                                                                              
  Next diagnostic plan, before estimator edits: analytic noise-only PSD bias. 
                                                                              
  For independent uniform x in [-a,a], sqrt-Hann w=sin(pi*n/N),               
  E|X[**k]|²=a²*N/6. For varying amplitude, use exact sum a[n]²*w[n]²/3. For K
  positive contiguous bins away from DC/Nyquist wrap, the normalized band-mean
  periodogram variance is (3K-1)/(2K²)-9/(5N), derived from adjacent-bin      
  window covariance and uniform fourth cumulant. Independent direct-f64       
  covariance/bin-pair sums already agree with the closed form at FFT512/2048  
  to 1e-12.                                                                   
                                                                              
  After the current exact-production restoration checks finish, add a test-   
  only baseline diagnostic: 64 predeclared nonzero seeds (ordinal 1..64 times 
  odd golden-ratio multiplier 0x9E3779B9 modulo 2^32), FFT512/2048, 48 kHz,   
  two independent channels. Channel 0 pure generated uniform-noise amplitude  
  .001 -> .1 for .25<t<.75 -> .001; channel 1 stationary amplitude .01. No    
  subtractive speech residue. Existing 720/128 DFT references and all original
  quality/noise-step/SDR/zero/heap guards stay unchanged. At requested centers
  .2,.3,.45,.6,.9, record mean raw observed PSD, mean/quantiles of MCRA PSD,  
  mean/weighted p and exact analytic expectation for each source window (1280 
  rows). Raw ensemble uncertainty does not calibrate a nonlinear posterior;   
  report observed distributions and PRNG limitations.                         
                                                                              
  No estimator change or retuning is authorized by a lower diagnostic bias    
  alone. Inspect noise-only bias and independently derive a published-equation
  reference before any IMCRA remedy. No author code copying without license;  
  author MATLAB was not downloaded and its URL times out. Held-               
  out/listening/native scopes remain pending, and all three owned plugins     
  remain partial.
